posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
As for Artscow, they are standard 2.5" by 3.5" playing cards custom printed front and back. They are not the exact same size as the Sentinels cards but are very close; as these are character cards we are talking about though, it is irrelevant. I can attest that the quality is good so long as the image resolution is high and you pay attention to the margin recommendations on the edge of the cards.

I had a few print and play games planned so, as I wanted actual cards rather than paste-ups, it was easy enough to fit the promos I didn't yet have into one of those jobs. Depending on what you need it might be worth the cost just for the promos rather than being gouged on eBay, or you can wait a couple of years for that promo pack

My hope is that every character will end up with two promos, but that's probably a pipe dream since several don't even have one yet.  My runner-up hope would be that there will be an additional promo each for Tachyon, Absolute Zero, and the Argent Adept (besides his upcoming PW version), so that the Freedom Five and the Prime Wardens will all have equal promo-y goodness....Dark Watch was first announced as a team, so I can live with not seeing a third version of each of those characters, and Ra and Visionary and the other loners can kinda suck it up.  But if the Prime Wardens turned out to be the last promos ever, then we'd have three versions each of Legacy, Wraith, Bunker, Haka, Fanatic and Tempest, two versions each of Tacky, AZ, Ra, Visionary, Unity, the four Dark Watch heroes, and Argent Adept, and only the originals for CR, OX, Scholar and the four Vengeance heroes other than Setback.  This would mean six over-blessed and seven under-represented heroes deviating from the ten-hero mean, and I'd be profoundly irritated by the asymmetry of it all.

I'm not sure I see the Scholar ever having a promo; him being the oddball he is, I think I can live with that.  O-X also seems rather singular, but I strongly hope to see a version of CR where he's back in the Sherrif of Silver Gulch days, with both his arms, but has encountered his future self and knows what's going on.  And I don't know how promo versions of the Sentinels might work; there might well just not be any.  I'm hoping for at least KNYFE to get a promo, since she's complexity 1 and thus will probably get boring fairly fast, so she'll want for an alternative version at some point.  Natch probably also has room for promos representing other sorts of animals or something, while for Parse I'm thinking it may not be too likely, but of course this is largely baseless speculation on my part.

I thought up a promo for Omnitron-X and Chrono-Ranger at one point. For Omnitron-X, it was "Specialized Plating." "Select a damage type not currently reduced by a plating card. Reduce all damage of that type dealt to Omnitron-X by 2 until the start of your next turn." Helps against people who like to throw around different types of damage (Ennead, Spite, Matriarch) and helps keep his components (not to mention himself) alive, at the cost of slowing down his setup.

 

Chrono-Ranger's promo would be him as the Sherrif of Silver Gulch. I couldn't decide between 2 options; one, a version of his normal power, but with 2 hands: "Dual-Wield: deal up to 2 targets 1 projectile damage each," but with a reduced HP of 26, or "Sherrif's Protection: Reduce damage dealt to hero targets by 1 until the start of your next turn." Helps mitigate some of the damage he tends to accumulate, at the cost of shooting now and then.

My favorite idea for an Omni-X promo was on BGG, "Select 2 components, their start of turn actions occur at the end of this turn as well."

I really like it, he doesn't set up as fast, and he doesn't help others with cards, but as long as those components are out he does a ton of stuff.

Interesting concept, but it would play rather horribly.  Only twelve cards in his deck have Accompany texts, and several of these are not that great (on your first turn, it's far from guaranteed that healing 2 HP or dealing 1 sonic damage is going to accomplish much, and you'd very rarely want to "vocalize" the Accompany of Alacritous Subdominant, since there's no chaining involved and you'd be giving up your card for pretty much nothing).  When he has no way to search for Songs other than Cadence, even losing the six Melody cards makes a pretty serious difference in usability.  No way in heck would I play this power.  Even making it possible to use the same one twice (not possible under your wording) would not make it worth it for me, though at least that way some players might consider it worth double-drawing for several turns to try and find a Preparation or Bulwark, so other players can play or draw two cards each turn.
